root_cause: A root-wide data-functional-delegating in-flight flag couples unrelated mount generations across SPA navigation. The next openPortalPage can replace a workspace while the previous styles/import is unresolved, leaving a skeleton missing its specialist. Exact-current-main production test run 39242832614 failed 1/16 on canvassen writeback due to no [data-functional-workspace=canvassen], although Netlify main SHA parity and 14 tests passed.
prevention_rule: Every portal workspace mount must own a unique active generation on the existing root; asynchronous stylesheet/module import and parity-attachment may only mutate the still-current generation. Navigation must not inherit a stale root-level in-flight lock. A test asserting server-confirmed demo canvas writeback remains mandatory; never skip or relax its UI assertion.
